metricsAddr.description: host:port the Prometheus exporter binds. Empty / unparseable disables the endpoint.

tcpListen.description: host:port the ensemble TCP transport binds for inbound peers. Omit / empty for dial-only (no listener). Plaintext — the signed ensemble hello is the only authentication on the wire; use iroh for non-LAN.

trustRemoteNurses.description: Let humd forward a prompt to a peer that advertises the model. A peer can claim any model it likes, so this is a trust decision, not a default. The env var HUM_TRUST_REMOTE_NURSES overrides it.

irohPort.description: UDP port the iroh (QUIC) transport binds for the ensemble. A fixed port keeps the address a peer is handed true across restarts; 0 takes an ephemeral port, which rots on every restart.

fs.description: Filesystem primitive — what humd is allowed to read and write. Built-in MCP tools (Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep/Bash) clamp to these roots. SpawnSpec.cwd must be inside one of them.

path.description: Absolute path or ~-relative. Tilde expanded against $HOME at load time.

mode.description: rw — read + write tools allowed. ro — Read/Glob/Grep allowed, Write/Edit refused.

denied.description: Hard blacklist. Any path under a denied prefix is refused even if it sits inside a root. Tilde expanded.
